name: Kentucky

default_limits.basis: KRS 189.390(3), state highways only: 65 interstates/parkways, 55 other state highways, 35 business/residential districts. Up to 70 where posted on listed interstates/parkways (189.390(4)). Cities/counties set limits on their own roads by ordinance (189.390(5)) - no statewide default there. 15 in off-street parking lots.

fine.notes: KRS 189.394 chart: bracket fine = base + per_mph x over ($1-5, $16-20, $22-40, $43-55). 26+ over: judge sets $60-$100. Court costs extra.

court_costs.notes: $100 district court costs (KRS 24A.175(1)) plus other statutory/local fees; total varies.

points.notes: 0 pts for 10 or less over on limited-access hwy (KRS 186.572). 26+ over: no points; mandatory hearing, up to 90-day suspension. 12 pts/2 yrs = hearing.

zones.work_zone: Fine doubled in highway work zones (KRS 189.394).
zones.school_zone: Fine doubled near schools when flashers are on (KRS 189.394).

court.reason: Above fine chart: cannot prepay, must appear; $60-100 fine; KYTC hearing, possible 90-day suspension.

trucks.notes: No truck-specific limit in KRS 189.390 text read.

sources.title: 2022 Ky. Acts ch. 35 (text of KRS 189.390 as amended)

notes: No criminal-by-speed threshold: speeding is a non-criminal violation. Reckless driving (KRS 189.290) has no speed number and is fined $20-100; wanton endangerment is a separate crime. Fine chart from 2023 bill reproduction of 189.394; official current page not read. KRS 431.452 (prepayment) amended eff. 7/15/2026 - details not reviewed.
